module_summary: SERV RISC-V top wiring the bit-serial serv_top core to an SRAM-backed register file via serv_rf_ram_if, which serializes/deserializes register accesses into serv_rf_ram.

anchors.name: o_ibus_adr
anchors.why: Instruction-fetch Wishbone address from the core's PC.

anchors.name: o_ibus_cyc
anchors.why: Instruction-bus cycle request, acknowledged by i_ibus_ack.

anchors.name: i_ibus_rdt
anchors.why: Fetched instruction word fed into the core decoder.

anchors.name: i_ibus_ack
anchors.why: Instruction-bus acknowledge completing fetch.

anchors.name: o_dbus_adr
anchors.why: Data-bus load/store address from the core.

anchors.name: o_dbus_dat
anchors.why: Store data written on the data bus.

anchors.name: i_dbus_rdt
anchors.why: Load data returned from the data bus.

anchors.name: o_dbus_cyc
anchors.why: Data-bus cycle request for loads and stores.

anchors.name: i_dbus_ack
anchors.why: Data-bus acknowledge ending load/store.

anchors.name: o_dbus_we
anchors.why: Data-bus write enable distinguishing store from load.

anchors.name: rf_wreq
anchors.why: Core register-file write request sequencing the RAM interface.

anchors.name: rf_rreq
anchors.why: Core register-file read request starting operand fetch.

anchors.name: rf_ready
anchors.why: RAM interface ready returned to core after register access.

anchors.name: rreg0
anchors.why: Source register index for read port 0; rreg1 is its twin.

anchors.name: wreg0
anchors.why: Destination register index for write port 0; wreg1 is its twin.

anchors.name: wen0
anchors.why: Write enable for register-file write port 0.

anchors.name: rdata0
anchors.why: Serial rs1 operand bit stream from RAM interface to core.

anchors.name: wdata0
anchors.why: Serial writeback bit from core to RAM interface.

anchors.name: waddr
anchors.why: SRAM write address generated by rf_ram_if for rf_ram.

anchors.name: raddr
anchors.why: SRAM read address generated by rf_ram_if for rf_ram.

anchors.name: wdata
anchors.why: Parallelized write data into register-file RAM.

anchors.name: rdata
anchors.why: RAM read data returned to rf_ram_if for serialization.

anchors.name: wen
anchors.why: SRAM write enable from rf_ram_if to rf_ram.

anchors.name: o_ext_rs1
anchors.why: Operand rs1 sent to external extension/MDU.

anchors.name: o_mdu_valid
anchors.why: Valid request to multiply/divide extension unit.

anchors.name: i_ext_ready
anchors.why: Extension unit ready with result i_ext_rd.

groups.name: SERV core
groups.description: Bit-serial RISC-V core driving ibus, dbus and extension interfaces.

groups.name: Register-file RAM interface
groups.description: Converts serial core register traffic to parallel SRAM accesses.

groups.name: Register-file RAM
groups.description: SRAM array storing GPRs and CSRs for the core.
